headline: Danaher (DHR) Stock Tries To Steady After A Sharp Post Earnings Selloff
summary: Danaher (NYSE:DHR) shares saw a sharp post earnings selloff, with heavy trading activity highlighting strong investor reaction. Following the drop, the stock closed near its daily highs, pointing to easing selling pressure and interest from buyers. The combination of intense volatility and late session stabilization has put Danaher back in focus for many shareholders.
